Growth.SasUiDescription: Thermal load, 0 = cold, 1 = fully heated. The single animated driver; the controller writes this through a generated curve binding.

HeatFlow.SasUiDescription: Computed at runtime, not authored. xyz is this piece's outward axis in its own object space and w is how far the piece sits along that axis from the ship centre, which together give one continuous ship-space coordinate so the heat front crosses piece boundaries. See evegraphics.controllers.statusEffectWiring. A zero direction means the piece heats uniformly.

HeatOutput.SasUiDescription: Intensity scales the emitted colour - push past 1 for bloom. Pulse nudges the coverage edge in place over time; 0 is static. Onset Bias delays this piece: 0 heats immediately, higher values wait until Growth passes them, so extremities can heat before the body.

HeatRange.SasUiDescription: Solar Coverage Cut lets the sun raise the coverage threshold on the shadow side. 0 by default because it is measured from the geometric normal, so on faceted plating it makes triangle boundaries visible - HeatSolar Facing already dims the shadow side smoothly without that. Peak Temperature caps how far up the incandescence ramp the hottest metal may go; below 1 keeps it red rather than white-hot. Anything that lowers this also scales the heat haze down, since both read the same heat value.

HeatShape.SasUiDescription: Where heat appears. Base Level heats the body of every panel and is what carries the effect. Occlusion holds buried volume back so the result is not perfectly flat. Edge Accent is a light touch of the curvature map so panel lines still read; keep it small, since an edge-led field only ever gives a glowing outline rather than heat across a surface. Coverage Softness is the width of the cold-to-glowing band - widen it if the transition looks hard or if triangle boundaries start showing.

HeatShimmer.SasUiDescription: Shimmer character. Scale is the size of the shimmer cells relative to the piece. Drift makes bands travel along the surface so it reads as heat rising off it - only the phase moves, never the hot pattern. Brightness is how much it flickers the glow as opposed to only nibbling the coverage edge. Speed scales the whole thing. HeatOutput.y is the master amount; 0 there disables all of it.

HeatShipRotation.SasUiDescription: Computed at runtime, not authored. The ship's world rotation quaternion, copied straight off the ship by an engine value binding so it arrives every frame. Identity when nothing is driving it.

HeatShipRotationLagged.SasUiDescription: Computed at runtime, not authored. The ship's rotation as it was several seconds ago, produced by an expression-curve filter on the ship. The rotation BETWEEN this and HeatShipRotation is the thermal lag: while the ship turns this trails behind and the sun direction used for heating lags the real one, and once the ship settles the two agree again so heating matches the true sun exactly. Zero length means nothing is driving it, in which case there is no lag. See evegraphics.controllers.statusEffectWiring.

HeatSolar.SasUiDescription: Solar heating, which tracks the sun automatically as the ship turns. Facing is how strongly the sun scales emitted heat - 0 heats the hull identically all round, 1 lets the shadow side fall to Shadow Floor. It scales heat rather than cutting coverage, so it stays smooth across faceted plating. Wrap softens the terminator. Shadow Floor is how much heat the unlit side keeps; raise it if orbiting the camera makes the effect look like it switches on and off. Both this and Shadow Floor need to be reasonably strong for the thermal lag to be visible, since the lag works by rotating the sun direction.

HeatSurface.SasUiDescription: Grunge Tile and Amount add fine surface grain from the hull's own grunge texture. Detail Fade is the distance in metres at which that grain has fully smoothed out. Rim Boost brightens grazing angles so thin metal reads as glowing through.

HeatTint.SasUiDescription: Multiplies the gradient colour. White leaves the ramp as authored.

HeatDistort.SasUiDescription: Strength is how far the haze bends the scene behind it, in screen terms before distance falloff. Chromatic splits the refraction into colour fringes. Scale sizes the haze cells relative to the piece. Rise makes the haze drift along the surface as if convecting off it.
